steps.en: Create a Python 3.12 env and install its long requirement list
steps.zh: 建 Python 3.12 环境，装它那一长串依赖

steps.en: Write your task notes, API key and model backends into the YAML config
steps.zh: 把你的任务笔记、API key 和模型后端写进 YAML 配置

steps.en: Launch the lab on that config
steps.zh: 用这份配置启动这个 lab

steps.en: Runs the literature review and folds what it read into a plan
steps.zh: 做文献回顾，把读到的收进研究计划

steps.en: In copilot mode, approve or correct each phase before it moves on
steps.zh: 开 copilot 时，每个阶段先由你确认或纠正再往下

steps.en: Prepares data and runs the experiments, the MLE-solver writing and repairing the code
steps.zh: 准备数据、跑实验，代码由 MLE-solver 写并自动修

steps.en: Interprets the results and writes the report in LaTeX
steps.zh: 解读结果，用 LaTeX 写成报告

steps.en: Scores the draft and can send the lab back for more experiments
steps.zh: 给草稿评分，必要时把 lab 打回去补实验

value.en: You stop carrying the whole research loop in your head: the phases run on their own, and in copilot mode each one pauses for your call
value.zh: 研究流程不再整个压在你脑子里：各阶段自己往前走，开 copilot 时每个阶段停下来等你拍板

sources: README.md (three primary phases: literature review, experimentation, report writing; copilot-mode flag; supported models o1/o1-preview/o1-mini/gpt-4o/o3-mini and deepseek-chat with --llm-backend; task_notes_LLM / task-notes for compute facts and style; state_saves checkpoints; pdflatex optional via --compile-latex "false"; AgentRxiv upload/retrieve; MIT license)

experiment_configs/MATH_agentlab.yaml (copilot-mode: True; research-topic; api-key; llm-backend: "o3-mini"; num-papers-lit-review; num-papers-to-write; mlesolver-max-steps / papersolver-max-steps; task-notes per phase; load-existing)

ai_lab_repo.py (the phases list: literature review, plan formulation, data preparation, running experiments, results interpretation, report writing, report refinement; report_refinement can reset the experiment phases and send the lab back)
mlesolver.py (MLE-solver command interpreter for the experiment phase, with GLOBAL_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS repair loop)
papersolver.py (paper-solver: arXiv SUMMARY / FULL_TEXT search tools, referee scoring via agents.get_score)
app.py (the AgentRxiv Flask + SQLite paper repository UI, SECRET_KEY placeholder)
